title: McLean Mortgage Data Breach
summary: People in the United States whose information may have been compromised in McLean's October 2024 data incident may be covered.
benefit: Class members may request credit monitoring, documented-loss reimbursement or a $45 alternative cash payment, subject to the administrator's rules.
proof: McLean incident notice with LoginID and PIN, if available
Documentation of qualifying unreimbursed losses, only if claiming those benefits
Correct mailing and contact information

questions.label: Were you residing in the United States when the incident affected you?
Was your personally identifiable information potentially compromised in McLean's October 2024 incident?
Are you an excluded McLean official, related party, judge or court staff?

title: Finastra Data Incident
summary: The administrator describes a class of U.S. residents sent a notice by Finastra that their private information may have been affected.
benefit: Possible cash and identity-protection benefits depend on the administrator's eligibility and claim instructions.
proof: Finastra incident notification letter or email
Any claimant identification supplied in the notice
Supporting records if claiming documented expenses

questions.label: Were you living in the United States when the incident affected you?
Did Finastra notify you that your private information may have been affected?
Are you an excluded Finastra official, government entity or related court party?

title: Kia Power Window Regulators
summary: A settlement involving covered Kia vehicles and alleged power-window regulator defects. Vehicle model, year and required documentation matter.
benefit: Potential repair reimbursement or dealer service-card benefits depend on the covered vehicle and claim type.
proof: Vehicle identification number (VIN), model year and ownership or lease records
Window-regulator repair invoices and payment proof, if seeking reimbursement
Administrator-approved evidence for the selected benefit

questions.label: Did you own or lease a vehicle included in the settlement's official covered-vehicle list?
Did you experience a covered window-regulator repair or are you seeking the alternative eligible owner benefit?
Can you identify the VIN and obtain required ownership or repair records?

title: Dr. Squatch Product Labeling
summary: Certain Dr. Squatch products marketed as natural and purchased in the United States during the covered purchase window may qualify.
benefit: Valid claimants may receive a pro-rata share; actual payment depends on eligible products, claims and settlement terms.
proof: Name and count of covered products purchased
Purchase dates between November 1, 2018 and August 29, 2026
Receipts or other records if requested by the official claim form

questions.label: Did you purchase the product in the United States?
Did you buy an item on the administrator's specific covered-product list?
Was the purchase between November 1, 2018 and August 29, 2026?

title: HireVelocity Data Incident
summary: U.S. residents who were sent written notice that their private information might have been compromised in the February 2025 incident may be covered.
benefit: Available cash and monitoring benefits depend on the administrator's requirements.
proof: Written HireVelocity data-incident notice
Claim ID or notice information, if provided
Proof for documented expense claims if applicable

questions.label: Did you reside in the United States?
Did HireVelocity send you written notice about its February 2025 data incident?
Are you excluded under the administrator's class definition?

title: Equifax Credit Reporting Coding Error
summary: A specific March–April 2022 Equifax coding issue may have affected information reported about some consumers to third parties. Ordinary Equifax users do not automatically qualify.
benefit: Potential pro-rata settlement payment to valid class members who file a timely claim; the administrator determines eligibility.
proof: Official Equifax settlement notice, if received
Claim ID/PIN or alternative administrator verification
Information needed to identify the affected credit-report event

questions.label: Did Equifax report information about you to a third party between March 17 and April 8, 2022?
Was that report affected by the specific coding issue described by the settlement administrator?
Have you received a class notice or confirmed your information with the settlement administrator?

title: Kroger Insured Prescription Pricing
summary: A settlement over insured prescription purchases at Kroger-family pharmacies during the official class period.
benefit: Potential share of the settlement fund; certain larger claims require supporting records.
proof: Prescription purchases made with insurance
Pharmacy purchase or insurance records
Supporting documentation if the claim totals $8,000 or more

questions.label: Did you pay for prescriptions at a Kroger-owned pharmacy?
Did you pay using prescription insurance?
Were qualifying purchases between December 9, 2018 and August 23, 2026?

title: Apple Intelligence Siri Advertising
summary: Certain U.S. purchases of eligible iPhone models in 2024–2025 are covered by allegations about advertised Siri Apple Intelligence features.
benefit: Potential settlement payment per qualifying device after validation; no amount is guaranteed.
proof: Proof of eligible iPhone model and purchase date
Information sufficient to confirm purchase or ownership
Statement addressing the advertised Siri features and expectations

questions.label: Was your eligible iPhone purchased in the United States?
Was it an eligible iPhone model on the administrator's list?
Was it purchased between June 10, 2024 and March 29, 2025?
At purchase, did you expect advertised Siri Apple Intelligence features that you did not receive?

title: Kelly Benefits Data Breach
summary: People living in the U.S. whose private information was compromised in the December 12–17, 2024 Kelly Benefits incident may be included.
benefit: Valid claimants may seek pro-rata payments, documented losses, monitoring or certain California benefits, as applicable.
proof: Kelly Benefits incident notice, if received
Documents showing data-breach-related loss, if claimed
California address on December 12, 2024, only for the separate California benefit

questions.label: Did you reside in the United States?
Was your private information compromised in the Kelly Benefits incident of December 12–17, 2024?
Are you excluded under the official settlement class definition?

title: GoodRx Data Disclosure
summary: U.S. individuals who used a GoodRx website, app or service before April 20, 2024 may be covered, subject to exclusions.
benefit: Possible pro-rata cash payment after a valid claim; the amount is not known in advance.
proof: Information identifying the GoodRx service used
Approximate usage date before April 20, 2024
Any notice or records requested by the administrator

questions.label: Were you a U.S. individual using the service?
Did you use a GoodRx website, mobile app or service?
Was that usage before April 20, 2024?

title: SeatGeek Nevada Ticket Fees
summary: Electronic tickets purchased for events in Nevada through SeatGeek between November 7, 2020 and May 12, 2025, with covered fees.
benefit: Potential pro-rata distribution based on fees retained for eligible purchases.
proof: SeatGeek ticket order for a Nevada event
Purchase date and fees charged
Notice LoginID/PIN if supplied by the administrator

questions.label: Were the tickets for an event in Nevada?
Did you buy them via SeatGeek's website or app and pay fees?
Was the purchase between November 7, 2020 and May 12, 2025?

title: RealPage Rental Software Antitrust
summary: Certain U.S. multifamily renters who paid rent at properties using covered RealPage revenue-management software during the class period may qualify.
benefit: Potential share of a settlement fund. The property and lease must meet the class definition; not all renters qualify.
proof: Rental property name and address
Lease and rental payment records within the class period
Whether the property used one of the covered RealPage systems, if known

questions.label: Was the rented multifamily property in the United States or its territories?
Did you pay rent there between October 18, 2018 and November 21, 2025?
Did the property use a covered RealPage revenue-management solution during your lease?

title: Non-Bank ATM Surcharge Fees
summary: Certain non-bank ATM cash withdrawals between October 24, 2007 and August 14, 2026 that included unreimbursed surcharges may be covered.
benefit: Potential settlement payment to members of the covered classes; eligible surcharge amounts and actual payment vary.
proof: Financial account or ATM transaction records, if available
Unreimbursed ATM surcharge amounts
Locations and dates of the covered ATM withdrawals

questions.label: Did you withdraw cash at a non-bank ATM covered by the settlement?
Were the withdrawals between October 24, 2007 and August 14, 2026?
Were the ATM surcharges not fully reimbursed by your bank?
